3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front view along the garden axis: central domed pavilion with the two long glasshouse wings and steps, blue sky

json.notes: The building is a glasshouse: a central domed pavilion at the centre of the south front, with long curved glazed conservatory wings extending left and right. The signature features are the tall central glass dome with a small cupola finial and the lower segmental glasshouse wings on brick plinths, framed in white. I model this as a central octagonal glass drum/dome plus two long arched glass vaults, with brick bases and small corner domes at the outer ends of the wings.
